gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-aref-ruqaa: Springy, hairline-free letters lead, while Aref Ruqaa underneath carries the soft variation of a lightly tilted nib. That gentle, dignified shift from rigid to soft is the pair's real draw.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-aref-ruqaa-ink: Rod-like and unshaded, Bellota Text bends every stroke like steel and takes charge at the top. Aref Ruqaa Ink then adds moderate contrast and open apertures, with strokes that never thin harshly.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-average: Commanding and unshaded, Bellota Text holds a constant pen pressure through every letter. Average, a serif with gaping mouths on the e and a faint swell in each curve, wants a generous body size.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-besley: Editorial and dignified, the body keeps its c curve far from closing, set against Bellota Text's single-weight outlines. Besley splits the difference between monoline and hairline strokes, so a modest bump in size helps.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-biz-udpmincho: Bellota Text draws each stroke at a single thickness, giving the top line a commanding, distinctive look. BIZ UDPMincho adds slightly thinner hairlines and gaps that stop letters crowding, which is the pair's whole charm.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-bona-nova: Commanding up top, Bellota Text sketches its letters like a pencil that never presses harder. And Bona Nova steps softly from heavy to light strokes, and its curves keep their mouths open paragraph after paragraph.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-bona-nova-sc: Bona Nova SC keeps every small counter unclogged, a refined classic serif with gentle modulation. Bona Nova SC rests the eye with modest weight swings, while Bellota Text rings out with a constant-walled o.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-brygada-1918: A monoweight stroke runs through all of Bellota Text, with no calligraphic shading to guide the eye. Brygada 1918 ebbs and flows in gentle swells like a worn felt marker, so paragraphs move along without strain.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-cactus-classical-: Cactus Classical Serif opens its e wide and lets its weights shift gently. Bellota Text, pipe-cleaner simple in every letterform, adds the commanding voice, so give the body a little extra size.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-caudex: Caudex reads with authority, its e gaping open and thin strokes only slightly lighter than the thick ones beside Bellota Text. Etched-glass subtlety against unshaded outlines is the draw.
